instructions.text: Read the entire method first and measure the following ingredients before turning on the heat: 1 cup butter; 2 eggs; 1 tsp vanilla; 2 cups sugar; 2 cups flour; 1.5 tsp cinnamon; 1 tsp salt; 3 cups oats; cranberries/raisins/coconut/nuts (optional). Keep ingredients marked optional separate until their step.

Set out the bowls, pans, measuring tools, and any baking equipment named in the steps below. Wash any fresh produce before use. Keep raw eggs, meat, and their utensils separate from ready-to-eat food.
Whisk butter, eggs, vanilla and sugar together
Add and combine flour, cinnamon, salt, oats, and optional add-ins
Mold and place ~24 golf sized balls of dough on trays with parchment paper
Cook for ~10 minutes or until edges begin to brown

Turn off any burners or oven when cooking is finished. Follow the cooling or resting instruction above before cutting or serving. Serve the finished dish as directed; allow hot portions to cool enough to eat.
